digest.component_or_area: MCP edge routing and TLS termination
propositions: The documented MCP client URL https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/mcp/ (with trailing slash) returns a 307 redirect to plaintext http:// because nginx uses a URI-preserving proxy_pass to an app mounted at /mcp without trailing slash, triggering Starlette's default redirect_slashes behavior

uvicorn's ProxyHeadersMiddleware defaults forwarded_allow_ips to 127.0.0.1, causing it to distrust X-Forwarded-Proto headers from nginx arriving via the Docker bridge gateway, so scheme-derived absolute URLs in Location headers are built as http:// despite nginx setting X-Forwarded-Proto: https
The nginx 443 server block lacks an HSTS header, so clients receive no mechanism to upgrade future http:// Location headers back to https on retry

A 307 redirect preserves method and body, and some HTTP clients retain Authorization headers across same-host scheme changes, exposing bearer PAT tokens to plaintext transmission when following the redirect

The fix requires: exact-match location blocks for /mcp/ and /mcp with URI-bearing proxy_pass to prevent the redirect, proxy_redirect directives to backstop any remaining http:// Location headers, HSTS header on the 443 server block, and FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS=* on the mcp compose service to trust the X-Forwarded-Proto header
